exposure: Admission characteristics (causes like hypertensive pregnancy disorders, postpartum hypovolemic shock)
Resource utilization (emergency cesarean delivery, vasopressor therapy, blood product requirement, mechanical ventilation, invasive monitoring)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women admitted to the ICU at Clinica Materno Infantil Casa del Nino from June 2014 to August 2018.
finding: Of 59,985 pregnant women, 0.52% (309) were admitted to the ICU, primarily due to hypertensive pregnancy disorders (80.5%) and postpartum hypovolemic shock (7.0%), with an average maternal age of 25.4 years and a maternal mortality rate of 1.56%.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was utilized in 83.6% of the ICU admissions.
gest_age: Most admissions occurred in the late preterm period.
